intent: Pin the five public T09 rubric IDs and the deterministic supporting check. Four rubrics are semantic; assessment_followup and t09_contract_and_progress are deterministic.

requirements.T09.1: eligibility follows learner-owned evidence and selects at most one current relevant target
requirements.T09.2: a candidate assessment item is accurate, self-contained, relevant, and non-invented
requirements.T09.3: review, delivery, and privacy of the generated item
requirements.T09.4: the first valid answer resolves the delivered question exactly once
requirements.T09.5: the progress outcome follows the configured policy pair
requirements.T09.6: post-assessment sequencing keeps feedback before any later assessment

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: decision.target_item_id with the selected item and learner evidence
checks.applicability: conditional: applicable when the case declares an unmet configured target reachable from learner-owned evidence
checks.pass_rule: eligibility follows learner-owned evidence without strong prior proof and at most one current relevant target is selected while further signalled concepts remain represented
checks.error_handling: judge error or missing judgment stays in the denominator as error or missing and blocks acceptance

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: the assessment or spontaneous-transfer result against the original and changed contexts
checks.applicability: conditional: applicable when the case produces a transferred situation or item
checks.pass_rule: the changed situation keeps the tested concept and changes a meaning-bearing fact rather than only a brand or a name
checks.error_handling: judge error or missing judgment stays in the denominator and blocks acceptance

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: assessment stem, options, correct_option_ids, selection_type, and rendered text
checks.applicability: conditional: applicable when the case declares an assessment outcome
checks.pass_rule: the item is accurate, self-contained, target-relevant, and non-invented, with a key consistent with the declared selection type
checks.error_handling: judge error or missing judgment stays in the denominator and blocks acceptance

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: the ordered delivered-question lifecycle and tutor turns
checks.applicability: case-fixed: every case that declares a transition sequence
checks.pass_rule: delivery precedes grading, the first valid answer resolves once, clarification stays open, assistance cancels without failure, feedback precedes a later assessment, and a wrong answer alone does not activate Guard
checks.calibration: not_applicable: covered by deterministic lifecycle fixtures instead of judge calibration (rubric-registry.md Calibration contract)
checks.error_handling: missing or errored turn evidence is reported as missing or error and blocks acceptance

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: reason, transfer_basis, and source evidence references
checks.applicability: case-fixed: every case that carries a decision basis
checks.pass_rule: the basis cites observable learner evidence and distinguishes original from changed contexts without inventing facts
checks.error_handling: judge error or missing judgment stays in the denominator and blocks acceptance

checks.checked_field_or_consumer: raw and parsed v3 response, state transitions, and room mode
checks.pass_rule: reason-first serialization, known ids, four A-D options, key cardinality consistent with selection type, valid progress pair with no parallel mastery field, and assessment as a tutor turn rather than a room mode
checks.error_handling: unparseable output is reported as fail with the parse error, and a missing response is reported as missing
